findings.claim: The artifact records all blocking constraints as passed even though the required build-only command is not evidenced anywhere in the task-5 receipts.
findings.evidence: Blocking constraint `build-passes` requires `cargo build --workspace && pnpm --dir web build && flutter analyze mobile`, while the retained receipts show only `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, focused Vitest, filtered Cargo tests, and FRF tests; `state.json` nevertheless records `blocking_constraints_passed: 11` and `blocking_constraints_total: 11`.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the exact build-passes command, retain its observed output, and only mark the constraint passed after the full command succeeds.

findings.claim: The retained verification does not satisfy the repository's required invariant-test command before claiming completion.
findings.evidence: Blocking constraint `invariant-tests-pass` requires `cargo test --workspace && flutter test mobile`, but the recorded Rust commands are only `cargo test -p aso-host projection::tests`, `cargo test -p aso-server-axum session::tests::mounted_registry_derives_two_practice_grants`, and `cargo test -p frf-gateway --features shape-facade --test shape_projection_grant`; no workspace Cargo test or Flutter test output is retained.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `cargo test --workspace && flutter test mobile`, retain the full output, and update the artifact state only if it succeeds.
